main_measure.name: abs(forecast)-weighted mean short-direction 5-day excess return over the coin's mean

statistic.name: t of the weighted mean, clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: > 0 with day-clustered t >= 2; reject: < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: size order: mean excess of larger half minus smaller half of abs(forecast)

decided_by: The day-clustered t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The profile is the regime 'unknown' and below-average a negative raw stretch; the coin's mean 5-day return is over its pooled non-overlapping grid of all windows; the larger half is abs(forecast) above the median (ties go to the smaller half), compared by unweighted means; the clustered t uses summed weighted deviations per UTC day with a G/(G-1) correction.
